_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,754 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with 197 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,754 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with 197 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.10x; +72% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.41; conservative 2yr +8%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.9%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +19.6%/yr (FY13 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.6%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2013-12-20) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.10x (58.3% downside to Bear $20 / +18.8% upside to Bull $57) | Adj composite 2.16 vs market 3.57: gap -1.41 [OVERVALUED] | +72% above the EPP floor $28 (13x FY13E $2.15) | Conservative 2-yr case: +8.4% total (+4.2%/yr) | At 22.3x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $63 sits above the BULL case; comps +6.2% in Q3 FY13, forward sales +6% (FY13 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2012 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2008-2012, income statement 2010-2012 with percent of sales, 2012 diluted shares 1,152M, interest $423M, income tax provision $1,178M on pre-tax $3,137M; cash, short-term investments, operating cash flow, capital expenditures; product-category sales (regrouped, prior years reclassified); $4.35B repurchased in 2012, $5.0B authorization remaining, the 2013 guide assumes about $4 billion of repurchases; 2012 fourth-quarter dividend $0.16; comparable store sales renamed comparable sales (a comparable location open longer than 13 months); 1,754 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, 197 million square feet

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2011 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2007-2011 (fiscal 2011 has 53 weeks), income statement 2009-2011 with percent of sales, 2011 diluted shares 1,273M, interest $371M, income tax provision $1,067M on pre-tax $2,906M; cash, short-term investments, operating cash flow, fixed assets acquired; product-category sales; $2.9B repurchased in 2011, $4.5B authorization remaining; 2011 fourth-quarter dividend $0.14; 1,745 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, 197 million square feet, 27 stores closed

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2010 10-K
